rows.label: qst501904_msg0001
rows.name: Thanks for your help last time, mo.

rows.label: qst501904_msg0002
rows.name:
Sennin is training intensely to become
a splendid Nopon sage, mo.

rows.label: qst501904_msg0003
rows.name:
I don't work or study. I just spend
all my time meditating to attain
enlightenment, mo.

rows.label: qst501904_msg0004
rows.name: So... I'd like an offering, mo.

rows.label: qst501904_msg0005
rows.name:
No, no! You're hesitating too much,
mo!

rows.label: qst501904_msg0006
rows.name:
Any food at all would be a welcome
offering to Sennin, mo!

rows.label: qst501904_msg0008
rows.name:
Sennin's belly is completely
satisfied, mo! Thank you, mo!

rows.label: qst501904_msg0010
rows.name:
I think it's about time to leave
Luxuria, mo.

rows.label: qst501904_msg0011
rows.name:
I'll seek enlightenment somewhere I
can receive lots of delicious food
like that, mo!

rows.label: qst501904_msg0012
rows.name:
Somewhere thick with trees, with a
big waterfall and lake, and plenty of
water...

rows.label: qst501904_msg0013
rows.name:
My dreams keep growing, mo. See you
somewhere again, mo!

rows.label: qst501904_msg0015
rows.name:
At this rate, they'll hold a memorial
for Sennin before I attain
enlightenment, mo...
